coverage.notes: The in-scope PUCPR/Kent State American Academy offering in Curitiba has two separately named first-year tracks: American Academy (general liberal arts/Bacharelado Interdisciplinar em Ciências e Humanidades) and American Academy Health (Bacharelado Interdisciplinar em Saúde). These are not 300 directly accessible English-taught undergraduate degrees in Curitiba: other named Kent State or PUCPR majors are later-stage options. The university 2027/1 listings and revised CONSUN admissions notices were located, but their text was not retrievable in full. Therefore the 2027 intake catalogue and all 2027-specific conditions remain to be checked before marking this enumeration complete. Advanced Programme, summer courses, exchanges and later-stage majors are excluded. No separate first-year faculty structure is advertised for this two-track programme.

programmes.about: A two-year, English-taught liberal arts pathway in Curitiba with Kent State faculty, an Associate of Science award and later choice of degree subject and campus.
programmes.overview: Students begin a modular liberal arts curriculum at PUCPR in Curitiba, taking Kent State classes in English without selecting a major on entry. Study spans humanities, social sciences and natural sciences, with activities involving communication, research, critical thinking and problem-solving. Kent State faculty teach the modules, and advisers help students choose a subsequent bachelor’s pathway. After four semesters, students who satisfy requirements receive a Kent State Associate of Science and may continue towards a bachelor’s at Kent State or PUCPR; a separate PUCPR interdisciplinary degree requires additional components.

programmes.overview: American Academy Health combines the Kent State liberal arts core with additional health-related study taught by PUCPR faculty in Curitiba. Students encounter different health fields and may use PUCPR laboratories and clinical simulation facilities, alongside broader academic skills and advising. Completing the initial phase can lead to an Associate of Science from Kent State and a Brazilian interdisciplinary health bachelor’s degree. Graduates may pursue other degrees or compete for a limited, separately assessed route into PUCPR Medicine; admission to Medicine is not automatic.
